issues.on_page: Use Fees 470,270.45 (Electric 378,126.87, Water 69,913.86, Sewer 22,229.72 utility fund sales)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: receipts[17] category set to Utility Charges, matching detail[67], [70], [78]] Utility fund use fees belong in the user's own category Utility Charges (2026-10-28 rule: utility fund sales/charges come out of charges for services). The detail lines for the same label (detail[67], [70], [78]) already use Utility Charges, so the report is inconsistent.

issues.extracted: business_type.debt_proceeds 287,315 (State Revolving Fund And Bond Proceeds)
issues.on_page: Exhibit IV nonoperating 'State Revolving Fund And Bond Proceeds' 287,315 (Electric 260,000, Water 27,315); the Statement of Activities (p2) shows the same 260,000 / 27,315 in the 'Operating Grants and Contributions' column
issues.issue: On p2 the report treats this money as operating grants; on p9 it treats it as bond/SRF proceeds. Only a person can settle whether it is loan proceeds (debt) or SRF grant/forgiveness. decision_needed doesn't cover it.

issues.on_page: Salaries: General Fund 69,414.50 (incl. Community Center 12,736.93, RV Park 7,733.67, Parks & Recreation 12,577.81 per p13-14), Street Fund 16,298.87
issues.issue: Lines that mix funds (Salaries, Professional Services, Insurance, Supplies - Operating, Capital Outlay - Equipment, Repair and Maintenance, Vehicle Expenses) are each put wholly under one function. p6-7 print the fund columns, so a split was possible. The dominant-category rule makes this defensible, but it hides about 32k of culture/recreation spending (Community Center, RV Park, Parks) inside general government.

User capital outlay rule (2026-10-26): the label should be 'Capital Outlay: <function>', with the printed text in printed_label. It isn't applied here, on business-type disbursements[25] 'Capital Outlay' 359,341.24 (p9), or on the detail capital outlay lines. user_rules.py may fix this.
The printed line combines highway allocation with motor vehicle fees. Highway allocation is the likely dominant part, but a mixed line should carry a review note.

The possible double reporting is filed as a report_discrepancy with difference 0, although the report's own totals add up. decision_needed already covers it. If the amounts are duplicated, governmental plus business-type receipts overstate taxes by 26,247.33.
